api.nicht_gefunden_404: YouTube cannot find this (404). For chat messages this usually means the broadcast is not running yet, so the chat is not open.
api.nur_testnutzer: Google only lets registered test users use this app until it has been verified. Add yourself: Cloud Console → APIs & Services → OAuth consent screen → Audience → Test users.
